Required Facts

Required facts using explicit input data. Returns a deterministic result without model calls or task execution.

Signature

required_facts(text, facts)

Example input

{
  "text": "Lint passed; unit tests passed.",
  "facts": [
    "lint",
    "unit tests",
    "integration"
  ]
}

Example output

{
  "present": [
    "lint",
    "unit tests"
  ],
  "missing": [
    "integration"
  ]
}

Run from repository root

python scripts/solve.py required_facts < examples/required-facts.json

Limits

Operates only on supplied data. Inspect source for validation and assumptions; this helper cannot establish real-world correctness.
